name: ISF Group Berhad
summary: ISF Group Berhad, an investment holding company, engages in supply and installation of piping systems in Malaysia. It offers piping for water supply and sewer infrastructure, as well as maintenance and repair services for piping systems. The company also undertakes projects through various property developments and infrastructure sectors, including industrial properties, data centres, and residential developments and commercial buildings. It serves project management companies, mechanical and electrical contractors, property developers, and property and business owners.
